CommandAccepted.description:
An accepted command (200). A repeated `Idempotency-Key` returns the first response for that
key, whatever its age (D-037).

events.description:
**The command's own events only**, never the events of advancing time to it: those can
be other players' owner-only information (D-030), so returning them would leak it. A
privacy requirement (D-045); the log's `own_events` count rebuilds the same list for a
repeated key.

game_time.description: The game time the command was applied at.

CommandRequest.description:
A command: one of the ten player actions, as `{"type": ..., "payload": {...}}`. It never
names the player, who comes from the auth token. Join game isn't here: the server issues it
on a player's first call (Decision 9), so `"type": "join_game"` is a 400 `malformed_body`.

ErrorBody.description:
Every error: `{"code": "no_free_slot", "message": "..."}`. `code` is the contract; `message`
is for people and may change.

message.description: A human-readable explanation; not part of the contract.

ErrorCode.description:
Every error code the API returns, with its status ([`ErrorCode::status`]). The 31 game codes
([`ErrorCode::is_game_rule`]) are the core's reason codes verbatim (D-028, D-029), and the
server's tests check the two lists are equal.

PlayerId.description:
A player: the UUIDv7 the accounts table assigns (Decision 9), hyphenated lowercase. The
server converts it; this crate checks only the text's form, the same form the schema's
pattern requires, so serde and the schema refuse the same strings.

Timestamp.description:
A game time: the universe epoch plus game time, as RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds, always
(`2026-10-01T21:00:00.000Z`). Game time is in milliseconds, so a time cut to seconds would be
off by up to 999 ms. The server formats it (P3.4, with D-044's stable epoch); this crate
checks the form and the calendar, as the schema's pattern and `date-time` format do.
